title: How Transformers Work in Artificial Intelligence

scenes.title: Introduction: The Transformer Revolution
scenes.visualDescription: A stream of text enters an animated AI system. Sequential arrows transform into a bright network of parallel connections spanning the entire sentence.
scenes.narration: Transformers changed AI by replacing slow step-by-step processing with parallel attention, allowing models to connect ideas across entire sequences at once.

scenes.title: The Problem with Traditional Sequential Models
scenes.visualDescription: An RNN and LSTM process words one at a time along a timeline. Signals weaken as they travel toward distant words, while a clock emphasizes slow processing.
scenes.narration: RNNs and LSTMs processed tokens sequentially, making training slow and causing early information to fade before distant words could connect reliably.

scenes.title: What Are Tokens?
scenes.visualDescription: A sentence breaks apart into colorful blocks labeled with words, subwords, and punctuation. Each block receives a numerical identifier and enters a computational pipeline.
scenes.narration: Before language can be processed, text becomes tokens: whole words, subwords, or punctuation, each assigned an identifier the model can compute with.

scenes.title: Token Embeddings and Positional Encoding
scenes.visualDescription: Token IDs expand into multidimensional vector points. Colorful sinusoidal waves wrap around the vectors, visibly marking each token's position in the sentence.
scenes.narration: Each token becomes a rich continuous embedding, then sinusoidal positional encoding adds mathematical information about its location, so order survives parallel computation.

scenes.title: Self-Attention
scenes.visualDescription: Every word in a sentence emits glowing lines toward every other word. Stronger connections illuminate relationships such as subject, action, and object.
scenes.narration: Self-attention lets every token compare with every other token simultaneously, discovering which words clarify, modify, or depend on one another across the sentence.

scenes.title: Query, Key, and Value
scenes.visualDescription: A database-style interface shows a Query searching through labeled Keys. Relevance scores adjust flowing Value cards, which merge into a contextual result.
scenes.narration: Think of a database: a Query asks what matters, matching Keys measure relevance, and weighted Values deliver the information needed for understanding.

scenes.title: Multi-Head Attention
scenes.visualDescription: Several parallel attention pathways analyze the same sentence. One highlights grammatical structure, another meaning, and a third links pronouns to earlier nouns.
scenes.narration: Multiple attention heads work in parallel, each learning a different perspective—syntax, semantics, or coreference—then their outputs combine into a richer representation.

scenes.title: Feed-Forward Networks and Transformer Layers
scenes.visualDescription: Attention outputs pass through stacked transformer blocks. Circular residual arrows preserve information, LayerNorm balances signals, and feed-forward networks reshape representations.
scenes.narration: After attention, residual connections preserve useful original information, LayerNorm stabilizes signals, and feed-forward networks transform each position, repeatedly refining representations through stacked transformer layers.

scenes.title: Conclusion: Powering Modern AI
scenes.visualDescription: The completed transformer expands into applications including a chatbot, translation tool, image system, coding assistant, and scientific research interface.
scenes.narration: Together, these scalable layers turn context into predictions, powering foundation models and large language models that generate, translate, reason, and drive modern AI.
